versions.changelog: Update API key setup and request routing

- Updated API key handling: now reads from a local api_key file in the skill directory only; no longer checks environment variables or user directories.
- Requests user confirmation before uploading documents or making destructive changes, unless already authorized.
- Changed handling of the internal sourceType parameter: now included in request details when requested.
- Added .clawhubignore to exclude local/private files from version control.
- Removed deprecated documentation and sync script.

- Added a requirement to include the internal routing parameter sourceType in every ComPDF API request, while ensuring it is not shown in any user-facing content.
- Removed the sample file skill-card.md.
- No user-facing functionality changes; documentation and workflow updated for compliance with internal routing.

- Removed the sample file skill-card.md.
- Updated the API key sign-in URL in SKILL.md to use a different referral/source tracking.

ComPDF Compress PDF skill initial release:

- Compress PDF files while balancing file size and readable visual quality.
- Supports selectable compression strategies, resolution control, and removal of non-essential content (like fonts, bookmarks, thumbnails).
- Provides precise workflow for preparing API requests using official ComPDF Server endpoints.
- Guides handling of API keys via secure local storage, with user instructions for obtaining new keys if missing.
- Includes safeguards and workflow steps for handling sensitive PDF operations.
- Aimed at facilitating PDF optimization in team and workflow contexts.
